# agent-box

> agent-box turns a spare Linux machine or a Windows gaming PC into on-demand, disposable Incus Linux boxes that coding agents use for heavy test suites, `-race`, and builds. Its CLI and MCP server is `box`.

Nothing is sent to agent-box.afig.dev by the `box` CLI, `boxd`, or `boxtray`. All snapshots and logs stay between your client machines and your own Incus host.

If your user asked you to set up agent-box, follow the setup page and ask your user before installing or running anything. If a host is already set up and your user only wants to connect this machine, follow the join page instead.

It works out of the box with T3 Code, Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity (`box join`), and with Cursor or any stdio MCP or shell agent.

When to use agent-box: when running heavy test suites (`go test -race`, full vitest/jest/pytest runs, Android Gradle unit tests), multi-target builds, or parallel test runs that would otherwise starve your laptop. Don't offload tiny checks that finish in a few seconds locally.

How to call it: once this machine has joined a host, `box mcp` exposes five tools: `box_status`, `box_run`, `box_job`, `box_cancel`, and `box_pull`. The `box` CLI provides the same commands plus `new`, `ls`, `rm`, `ui`, `app`, `join`, and `update`.

## Agent pages

- [Set up agent-box](https://agent-box.afig.dev/setup): for an agent asked to set up a host or connect a client
- [Join a host](https://agent-box.afig.dev/join): for an agent connecting a laptop to an existing Incus host
- [Use agent-box](https://agent-box.afig.dev/use): the five MCP tools, sizes, queue, and exit codes once joined

## Install

- [install.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Fig/agent-box/main/install.sh): Linux and macOS, `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Fig/agent-box/main/install.sh | sh`
- [install.ps1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Fig/agent-box/main/install.ps1): Windows PowerShell, `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Fig/agent-box/main/install.ps1 | iex`

## Optional

- [README](https://github.com/a-Fig/agent-box): overview, measured benchmarks, and CLI reference
- [How agent-box runs](https://agent-box.afig.dev/how/): step-by-step walkthrough of bundles, `/cache`, queueing, RAM reclaim, digests, and pulls
- [Hosts & GPUs](https://agent-box.afig.dev/hosts/): dedicated Linux hosts, Windows PC modes, GPU passthrough, and queue behavior
- [Provisioning guide](https://github.com/a-Fig/agent-box/blob/main/provision/README.md): Linux server and Windows PC setup scripts and undo steps
- [Queue design](https://github.com/a-Fig/agent-box/blob/main/docs/queue.md): how `boxd` schedules waiting runs
